description_en: Performs a paging query for skills visible to the current invoker

kebab_example: aliyun ada list-skills --max-results 20 --next-token eyJzIjoiZDc3ZGRhYmE3MDMwYWM1NCIsInAiOjJ9.vkKVySx9G26993sTNLZqwGSmgciRsrRm2SgsjOMJoCQ --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --creator-id example-user --biz-q review --visibility user --scope CUSTOM --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSkills

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for cursor-based pagination. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: `20`. If this parameter is explicitly specified, cursor-based pagination takes precedence
parameters.help_zh: 游标分页的每页数量，取值范围为 1～100，默认值为 `20`。显式传入时优先使用游标分页
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The next token returned by the server. Do not specify this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, use the value from the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 服务端返回的下一页令牌。首次查询时不传，后续查询时使用上一次响应中的值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The compatible page number parameter for page number-based pagination. Pages start from 1. Default value: `1`
parameters.help_zh: 兼容的页码分页参数，从 1 开始，默认值为 `1`
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The compatible number of entries per page for page number-based pagination. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: `20`
parameters.help_zh: 兼容的每页数量，取值范围为 1～100，默认值为 `20`
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Filters skills by the creator ID
parameters.help_zh: 按 Skill 创建者 ID 过滤
parameters.name: creator_id

parameters.help_en: Performs a fuzzy match on the skill name or description
parameters.help_zh: 按 Skill 名称或描述模糊匹配
parameters.name: q

parameters.help_en: Filters skills by visibility. Common values are `user` and `tenant`
parameters.help_zh: 按可见性过滤。常用值为 `user` 和 `tenant`
parameters.name: visibility

parameters.help_en: The query scope for skills. Valid values: `SYSTEM` and `CUSTOM`. If this parameter is omitted, both official and custom skills are queried
parameters.help_zh: Skill 查询范围。可选值为 `SYSTEM` 和 `CUSTOM`；省略时合并查询官方和自定义 Skill
parameters.name: scope

MaxResults.description_en: The current number of entries per page for cursor-based pagination
MaxResults.description_zh: 当前游标分页的每页数量

NextToken.description_en: The next token. An empty string is returned if there are no more pages
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页令牌。没有下一页时返回空字符串

PageSize.description_en: The current compatible number of entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 当前兼容分页的每页数量

Skills.description_en: The list of skill summaries. The structure of list items is not fixed in the current public contract. For common fields, refer to the supplementary description of response parameters
Skills.description_zh: Skill 摘要列表。当前公共契约未固定列表项结构，常见字段参见“返回参数补充说明”

items.description_en: The skill summary list item. For common fields, refer to the supplementary description of response parameters
items.description_zh: Skill 摘要列表项，常见字段参见返回参数补充说明

Total.description_en: The total number of skills that meet the current visibility and filter conditions
Total.description_zh: 符合当前可见性和过滤条件的 Skill 总数
